members.name: language
members.doc: A Shiki language name or alias. It colours the code once the highlighter loads, and labels the header when filename is absent. A missing or unsupported language stays plain text.

members.name: filename
members.doc: Labels the listing in the header.

members.name: lineNumbers
members.doc: Whether line numbers show. A diff shows original and updated positions.

members.name: copyable
members.doc: Whether the copy action shows. It copies the exact source, or in diff mode the exact after.

members.name: wrap
members.doc: Whether long lines wrap. When false, they scroll horizontally.

types.name: CodeBlockArms
CodeBlockOwnProps

members.name: mode
members.doc: What the block shows. In code mode it shows source. In diff mode it shows a line diff from before to after. A mode takes only its own inputs: code mode takes source and not before or after, and diff mode takes before and after and not source.

members.name: source
members.doc: The code to show, in code mode. It is required there and not allowed with before or after. At most 1,000,000 UTF-16 units and 10,000 lines.

members.name: before
members.doc: The original code, in diff mode. It is required there with after, and not allowed with source. At most 1,000,000 UTF-16 units and 10,000 lines.

members.name: after
members.doc: The updated code, in diff mode. It is required there with before, and not allowed with source. The copy action copies it. At most 1,000,000 UTF-16 units and 10,000 lines.
